reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 12.3 directly supports it: it expressly preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, which meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding that benefits our party; the rendered redline is identical to the original text.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable here — they presuppose an existing non-solicit covenant, and no such covenant binds Customer, so they are not evidence of error.
Rationale appropriately notes § 12.4's restraint on Vendor as out of scope for a rule aimed at covenants binding Customer, avoiding double-flagging.
